description: This file defines an interface named SavingsProductReadPlatformService, which provides methods for retrieving savings product data.

classes.name: SavingsProductReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve savings product data, including retrieval by various filters.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieve all savings product data optimized for lookup.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookupByType
methods.description: Retrieve savings products for lookup filtered by whether they are overdraft types.

methods.name: retrieveAllForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieve savings products filtered by currency code.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieve a single savings product by its ID.
